text: A farmer was hoeing his field one spring morning.
Out of the grass, a hare came racing,
ran straight into an old tree stump, and fell still.
"Dinner, for free!" the farmer laughed. "Why work at all?"
He put down his hoe, sat by the stump, and waited.
By autumn, his field was wild, and his bowl was empty.
His neighbors carried home their rice. He was still waiting.
Luck visits once. Work feeds you every day.
